arguments.sql: SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema='public' AND table_type='BASE TABLE') AS actual_tables, (SELECT count(*) FROM public.schema_tables_registry WHERE scope='server' AND engine='postgresql' AND schema_name='public' AND is_active) AS registered_tables, (SELECT count(*) FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema='public') AS actual_columns, (SELECT count(*) FROM public.schema_columns_registry WHERE scope='server' AND engine='postgresql' AND schema_name='public' AND is_active) AS registered_columns;
